name: Manami no Doko made Iku no?
original_name: まなみのどこまでイクの？
source:
Manami was just about to begin enjoying her summer vacation, when she received a strange letter. The sender implies that Manami has been chosen as a heroine, and her task is to stop a criminal syndicate in her home town. As the girl begins investigating nearby areas, she meets a mysterious masked person known as Black Pack, and delves deeper into conspiracies and bizarre sexual encounters.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/manami-no-doko-made-iku-no]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
真奈美正准备好好享受暑假，却收到一封奇怪的来信。寄信人声称她已被选为女英雄，任务是阻止盘踞在家乡的犯罪集团。调查周边地区时，她遇见一名号称“黑帕克”的神秘蒙面人，也一步步深入错综复杂的阴谋与离奇的性遭遇之中。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/manami-no-doko-made-iku-no]Moby Games[/url]]
